name: jyu_slam_hold
desc: Same character, same size, same colors, cream pattern and leaned-back upright pose with the broad chest and huge round belly pushed forward to the left, standing with both feet planted on the ground. Change only the arms: both hands rest on his hips, elbows out. The head and face stay exactly the same: the same thick angular black eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. Thick paint dripping. Same outline and pixel art style.
